# National Park Service
> The official website of the U.S. National Park Service for finding parks, planning visits, and exploring America's natural and cultural heritage.

NPS.gov is the primary public resource for national parks, monuments, historic sites, trails, rivers, seashores, and related programs managed by the National Park Service. It combines trip-planning tools, park-specific visitor information, educational topics, maps, fees and passes, and nationwide directories by state, topic, and park type.

## Core Site Navigation
- [NPS.gov Homepage](https://www.nps.gov/index.htm): Main entry point for discovering parks, stories, and visitor planning resources.
- [Find a Park](https://www.nps.gov/findapark/index.htm): Search and browse national park sites by name, state, activity, or topic.
- [Maps](https://www.nps.gov/maps/index.htm): Access national park maps and geospatial resources across the system.
- [Park Types](https://www.nps.gov/aboutus/national-park-system.htm): Overview of the different designations within the National Park System.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.nps.gov/aboutus/faqs.htm): Answers to common questions about parks, passes, fees, and operations.

## Trip Planning
- [Plan Your Visit](https://www.nps.gov/planyourvisit/index.htm): Central trip-planning hub for visiting parks across the National Park System.
- [Entrance Fees](https://www.nps.gov/aboutus/entrance-fee-prices.htm): Information about entrance fees charged at participating park sites.
- [Passes](https://www.nps.gov/planyourvisit/passes.htm): Overview of national park passes and related visitor access programs.
- [America the Beautiful Pass Series](https://www.nps.gov/planyourvisit/passes.htm): Federal recreational pass options for public lands and waters.
- [Fee-Free Days](https://www.nps.gov/planyourvisit/fee-free-parks.htm): Annual schedule of dates when entrance fees are waived.
- [Reservations](https://www.nps.gov/planyourvisit/park-reservation-system.htm): Guidance on reservation requirements and booking systems at selected parks.
- [Accessibility](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/accessibility/index.htm): Accessibility information, services, and planning resources for visitors.
- [Safety](https://www.nps.gov/planyourvisit/safety.htm): General safety guidance for outdoor recreation and park visits.

## Nature and Science Topics
- [Plants](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/plants/index.htm): Resources on native plants, vegetation, and botanical conservation in parks.
- [Animals](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/animals/index.htm): Information about wildlife, habitats, and species stewardship across park units.
- [Geology](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/geology/index.htm): Geologic features, processes, and earth science interpretation in parks.
- [Climate Change](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/climatechange/index.htm): National Park Service climate science, impacts, and adaptation resources.
- [Air Resources](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/air/index.htm): Air quality monitoring and atmospheric resource protection information.
- [Water Resources](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/water/index.htm): Water science, aquatic ecosystems, and watershed protection resources.
- [Fire](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/fire/index.htm): Wildland fire management, prescribed fire, and fire ecology information.
- [Natural Sounds and Night Skies](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/sound/index.htm): Resources on soundscapes, noise impacts, and dark sky protection.

## History, Culture, and Heritage
- [History & Culture](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/history/index.htm): Broad gateway to historical interpretation and cultural heritage topics.
- [Civil Rights](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/civilrights/index.htm): Resources on civil rights history, places, and preservation programs.
- [African American Heritage](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/africanamericanheritage/index.htm): Stories, places, and programs related to African American history.
- [American Indian Heritage](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/americanindianheritage/index.htm): Resources on Indigenous history, culture, and partnerships.
- [Latino Heritage](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/latinoheritage/index.htm): National Park Service materials on Latino history and heritage.
- [Asian American and Pacific Islander Heritage](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/asianpacificheritage/index.htm): Resources on AAPI history, places, and interpretation.
- [Women's History](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/womenshistory/index.htm): Stories and places connected to women's history in America.
- [Military](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/military/index.htm): Military history resources spanning conflicts, battlefields, and memorial landscapes.

## Education and Youth
- [Education](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/education/index.htm): Teaching resources, lesson materials, and education program information.
- [For Teachers](https://www.nps.gov/teachers/index.htm): Classroom resources and curriculum materials for educators.
- [For Kids](https://www.nps.gov/kids/index.htm): Youth-focused activities, games, and learning resources about parks.
- [Junior Ranger](https://www.nps.gov/kids/juniorrangers.htm): Information about the Junior Ranger program and participation opportunities.
- [Every Kid Outdoors](https://www.nps.gov/kids/every-kid-outdoors.htm): Fourth-grade access program information and park visit resources.
- [Distance Learning](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/education/distancelearning.htm): Remote learning programs and virtual educational offerings from parks.

## Preservation and Stewardship Programs
- [Subjects](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/index.htm): Directory of National Park Service subject areas, programs, and initiatives.
- [Historic Preservation](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/historicpreservation/index.htm): Preservation laws, programs, and technical assistance for historic resources.
- [National Register of Historic Places](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/nationalregister/index.htm): Official information about listing and researching historic places.
- [National Historic Landmarks](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/nationalhistoriclandmarks/index.htm): Program information on nationally significant historic properties.
- [Archeology](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/archeology/index.htm): Archeological research, stewardship, and public interpretation resources.
- [Cultural Landscapes](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/culturallandscapes/index.htm): Guidance and information on preserving historic and designed landscapes.
- [Museum Management](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/museum/index.htm): Resources related to museum collections and object stewardship.
- [Tribal Preservation](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/tribalpreservation/index.htm): Programs and resources supporting Tribal historic preservation efforts.

## Maps, Media, and Publications
- [Photos, Videos, Webcams & More](https://www.nps.gov/media/index.htm): Central media hub for images, video, webcams, and multimedia content.
- [News](https://www.nps.gov/news/index.htm): National Park Service news releases and announcements.
- [Park Brochures](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/brochures/index.htm): Access brochures and print-style visitor publications for parks and programs.
- [Multimedia Search](https://www.nps.gov/media/multimedia-search.htm): Searchable library of NPS multimedia assets and related content.
- [Webcams](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/webcams/index.htm): Live and archived webcam views from selected national park sites.
- [Publications](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/publications/index.htm): Reports, handbooks, and other official National Park Service publications.

## About the National Park Service
- [About Us](https://www.nps.gov/aboutus/index.htm): Overview of the agency, mission, leadership, and organizational information.
- [National Park System](https://www.nps.gov/aboutus/national-park-system.htm): Summary of the scope and composition of the National Park System.
- [Our Mission](https://www.nps.gov/aboutus/our-mission.htm): Mission statement and purpose of the National Park Service.
- [Leadership](https://www.nps.gov/aboutus/leadership.htm): Information about agency leadership and senior officials.
- [Laws & Policies](https://www.nps.gov/aboutus/lawsandpolicies.htm): Legal authorities, policy guidance, and governing frameworks for the agency.
- [Contact Us](https://www.nps.gov/aboutus/contactus.htm): Agency contact information and ways to reach National Park Service offices.
- [Work With Us](https://www.nps.gov/aboutus/workwithus.htm): Employment, volunteering, concessions, and partnership opportunities.
- [Doing Business With Us](https://www.nps.gov/aboutus/doingbusinesswithus.htm): Contracting, procurement, and business-related information for partners and vendors.
